interpretation_limits: Do not identify the IR 143 infantry captain, the 17 Feldartillerie-Brigade adjutant, or the reserve lieutenant in other results with each other solely from their surname.
Later secondary biographies of Ernst von Strzemieczny do not establish that he is the p224 officer.
The independent 1917 Breslau VI Corps decree has no surname linkage.
The p224 STRZEMIECZNQ to Strzemieczny reading remains a lexical hypothesis; no Q to Y or numerical reassignment is applied.
